mainEntity.name: Do I need to sign up in advance for SHRED classes at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is recommended to sign up in advance for SHRED classes to secure your spot, as class sizes may be limited. Advance registration also helps coaches prepare for attendance numbers and ensures a smooth start to each session. You can typically register through our online schedule or by contacting Cave Training directly. Walk-ins might be accommodated if space is available, but pre-registration is preferred.
